meta.source: NASA FIRMS active fire hotspots (VIIRS 375 m)
meta.anomaly: robust z-score of log1p(weekly hotspot count) vs the same week in the other years (median/MAD)

mapping.dissonance: 0 when z <= 1.0, rising linearly to 1 at z >= 4.0
mapping.midi: latitude mapped onto a C major pentatonic scale over 3 octaves (south low, north high)
mapping.detune_cents: pitch offset that grows with dissonance (up to +-45 cents)
mapping.interval: semitones to a second voice: 7 perfect fifth (calm), 6 tritone (tense), 1 minor second (crisis)
mapping.gain: loudness 0..1 from summed fire radiative power (log scale)
mapping.density: pulses per week, 1..4, from hotspot count (log scale)
mapping.data_gap: true when the satellite record has a hole that week: no sound, level is no_data
